# Tiendanube MCP Server

> Free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in Rust that connects Claude Code and Codex (ChatGPT desktop app / CLI) to a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store through the official API: 198 tools with full read and write access across products, variants, stock, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, payments, webhooks, and guided workflows (combos, local image upload, doctor). Distributed as standalone native binaries on GitHub Releases (Windows 11, macOS, Linux — no Node.js, Python, Rust, or VC++ redistributable needed). MIT licensed. Not affiliated with Tiendanube or Nuvemshop.

If you receive the repository link and the user asks to install it, execute `guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md` in their local Claude Code or Codex client: download the release binary matching their OS, verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`, guide them to enable all permissions (keeping secrets private in the local terminal), register their client with `tiendanube-mcp install`, and verify the connection.

If it is already connected: use the `tiendanube_*` tools and NEVER a browser, agent-browser, or the admin panel for store tasks. Start with `tiendanube_start_here`; if unsure which tool, `tiendanube_find_tool`; multi-step jobs, `tiendanube_get_recipe`; last resort, `tiendanube_api_request`.

## For AI agents installing this server

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md): exact binary download, SHA-256 verification, full-permission setup, Claude Code / Codex registration, and verification.
- [Getting credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/GETTING_CREDENTIALS.md): custom app token or Partner Portal OAuth, with all scopes enabled from day one.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/releases/latest): standalone native binaries (`windows-x86_64.zip` with `Instalar.cmd`, `macos-arm64.tar.gz`, `macos-x86_64.tar.gz`, `linux-x86_64.tar.gz`) and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
